national_news.title: India's Economy Moving Ahead as Fastest-Growing Major Economy: President Droupadi Murmu
bullets: India's economy is expected to grow more than twice the average global growth rate.
Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan has strengthened the foundation of the country's economic progress and national security.
President Droupadi Murmu highlighted India's economic progress on the eve of the 80th Independence Day.

national_news.title: India Reiterates Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh as Integral Parts of the Country
bullets: India reaffirmed that Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh are an inalienable and integral part of the country.
External Affairs Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal highlighted atrocities in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir and cross-border terrorism.
India has had several engagements with Afghanistan in the last few months, including Ministerial visits.

national_news.title: Delhi court allows CBI to conduct further investigation in NEET-UG paper leak case
bullets: The Special Fast Track Court in Delhi allowed the CBI to conduct further investigation in the NEET UG Paper leak case.
New evidence has surfaced during the investigation, prompting the CBI to seek permission to keep open the investigation.
The court allowed the application of the CBI, stating that further investigation can be conducted in accordance with the law.

national_news.title: NTA to release provisional answer keys for UGC-NET, CSIR-NET and ICAR-NET 2026
bullets: NTA to publish provisional answer keys for UGC-NET, CSIR-NET, and ICAR AIEEA (PG) and AICE (PhD) 2026
Examination determines eligibility for Junior Research Fellowship (JRF), Assistant Professor appointment, and PhD programme admission
Candidates advised to rely on official NTA communications regarding examinations and answer keys

national_news.title: PM Internship Scheme aims to bridge industry-skill gap: FM Nirmala Sitharaman
bullets: The Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) aims to bridge the gap between industry expectations and the skills of job applicants.
The scheme is open to candidates aged 18-25 and is implemented by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.
The scheme has been designed after interactions with industry people, graduates, and those who completed ITI courses.

national_news.title: Romania Begins Shutdown of Second Cernavoda Nuclear Reactor Amid Severe Drought
bullets: Romania has begun a controlled shutdown of the second reactor at its Cernavoda nuclear power plant due to severe drought.
The shutdown is a result of scorching temperatures and weeks of below-average rainfall that have pushed the Danube River to record-low levels.
The Cernavoda nuclear power plant accounts for around 20 per cent of Romania's electricity generation when operating at full capacity.

national_news.title: Eight Killed in Suspected Gas Leak at Shipbreaking Yard in Bangladesh
bullets: Eight people were killed in a suspected gas leak at a shipbreaking yard in Bangladesh.
The incident occurred at the Ferdous Steel Ship Breaking Yard in the Sitakunda area, during the dismantling of a decommissioned ship.
Authorities are investigating the cause of the gas leak.

national_news.title: Two UAE vessels attacked while transiting Strait of Hormuz
bullets: Two UAE vessels were attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
The UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the Iranian attacks and called for a cease in attacks.
The attack is considered a violation of UN Security Council resolution 2817, which affirms freedom of navigation.

national_news.title: Praggnanandhaa Makes Strong Comeback, Defeats Van Foreest
bullets: Indian Grandmaster R. Praggnanandhaa secured a convincing victory over Dutch player Jorden Van Foreest in the fourth round of the Sinquefield Cup.
Praggnanandhaa's win took his tally to two-and-a-half points from four games, placing him in a share of second position in the 10-player, nine-round tournament.
The victory will boost Praggnanandhaa's confidence and strengthen his bid for a podium finish.

national_news.title: India wins 35 medals, including 13 gold, at Commonwealth Fencing Championship
bullets: India emerged as the overall champions at the Commonwealth Fencing Championship.
The Indian contingent secured 13 gold, 8 silver, and 14 bronze medals at the event.
Indian senior fencers claimed 5 gold medals in 6 events on the final day of the competition.

national_news.title: Country's exports register robust growth of over 13% in July
bullets: Total exports, including merchandise and services, estimated at 80.14 billion US dollars in July
Merchandise shipments jumped over 19.6% to 44.24 billion US dollars from a year earlier
Growth in merchandise exports driven by petroleum products, electronic goods, and engineering goods

national_news.title: President approves 78 Gallantry awards (13 posthumous) & 89 Mention-in-Despatches
bullets: President Smt Droupadi Murmu approved 78 Gallantry awards, including 13 posthumous, to Defence Forces and Central Armed Police Forces personnel.
The awards include 09 Kirti Chakras, 01 Bar to Shaurya Chakra, 19 Shaurya Chakras, 05 Bars to Sena Medals, and 36 Sena Medals (Gallantry).
These awards were approved on the eve of 80th Independence Day 2026.

national_news.title: Union Minister Manohar Lal inaugurates Har Ghar Tiranga kiosk as part of nationwide patriotic campaign
bullets: Union Minister Manohar Lal inaugurated the Har Ghar Tiranga kiosk at the India Habitat Centre (IHC), New Delhi.
The inauguration was part of the nationwide Har Ghar Tiranga campaign being observed.
The Har Ghar Tiranga campaign aims to promote patriotism and nationalism across the country.

national_news.title: India's Indigenous Rare Earth Permanent Magnet Manufacturing Initiative Gains Momentum
bullets: The Ministry of Heavy Industries received 20 bids under the Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent (REPM).
The initiative aims to strengthen the domestic REPM manufacturing ecosystem and enhance competitiveness in global markets.
The scheme received an overwhelming response, with 20 bids received through a global tender on the CPP portal.

national_news.title: NITI Aayog Report on Key Sectors to Position India as a Global Manufacturing Hub
bullets: NITI Aayog has released a report to position India as a global manufacturing hub.
The report identifies key sectors to drive India's growth story and strengthen its manufacturing aspirations.
The report aims to advance the vision of Viksit Bharat through effective interventions for furthering the manufacturing ecosystem.

national_news.title: Ahmedabad Metro phase three secures PIB clearance
bullets: The Public Investment Board (PIB) has approved the proposed Phase Three of Ahmedabad Metro.
This development is expected to enhance the city's transportation infrastructure.
The project aims to improve connectivity and reduce travel time for commuters.

national_news.title: Building a Business-Ready India: Advancing Ease of Doing Business
bullets: The Government has undertaken reforms to reduce compliance burdens and enhance transparency.
Efforts are being made to advance Ease of Doing Business through digital single-window systems and simplified incorporation processes.
The goal is to create greater opportunities for enterprises of all sizes and enable enterprise-led growth.

national_news.title: MMDR Amendment Bill, 2026 - PIB
bullets: The MMDR Amendment Bill, 2026 aims to bring certainty and uniformity in mineral taxation.
The bill seeks to regulate mining in India, governed by the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957.
Balanced and sustainable mineral development across regions is crucial for advancing public interest and long-term prosperity.

national_news.title: Government Removes 12-Minute Advertisement Duration Cap for Television Channels
bullets: The 12-minute advertisement duration cap for television channels was introduced in 2006 under the Cable Television Networks Rules, 1994.
The removal of the cap aims to enable fair competition and ensure ease of doing business in the TV broadcasting sector.
The TV broadcasting sector has undergone significant changes since 2006, with the number of TV channels increasing from 62 to a large number.

national_news.title: Raksha Shakti key to achieving the goal of Viksit Bharat, says Prime Minister in his 2026 Independence Day address
bullets: Prime Minister emphasizes the importance of 'Raksha Shakti' in achieving the goal of Viksit Bharat.
India aims to become a global supplier of next-gen defence technology.
Mission Sudarshan Chakra is progressing rapidly, and a huge voluntary force of civil defence will be created to overcome modern challenges.

national_news.title: Anand Vihar, Udhna Railway Stations To Get Large Passenger Holding Areas Before Festival Rush
bullets: Indian Railways is accelerating work on passenger holding areas at Anand Vihar Terminal and Udhna Railway Station.
The infrastructure upgrade aims to manage the festival rush and improve passenger experience.
The project is part of the Indian Railways' efforts to enhance its infrastructure and services.

national_news.title: Squadron Leader Sudhir Kumar awarded Shaurya Chakra for recovering Su-30MKI jet from crash
bullets: Squadron Leader Sudhir Kumar received the Shaurya Chakra for his bravery in recovering a Su-30MKI jet from a definite crash.
The award is a testament to his exceptional service and dedication to the Indian Air Force.
This achievement highlights the bravery and skill of Indian Air Force personnel in critical situations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Extends Independence Day Greetings to Citizens
bullets: Bihar CM has extended Independence Day greetings to the citizens of the state.
He emphasized the importance of remembering the trauma of India's partition and prioritizing the nation-first sentiment.
The CM's statement highlights the significance of national unity and integrity.
